title: South Africa plans exchange controls for offshore crypto, stablecoin flows
message_html: South Africa plans exchange controls for offshore crypto, stablecoin flows ...
snippet: South Africa has proposed new rules that would limit certain offshore transfers of cryptocurrencies and stablecoins.
